ratings.note: f: keyboard users on days with Few-left slots (screenshot shows 10 such slots on Saturday); i: focus jumps between a top band and Morning/Afternoon groups, easy to lose place on the core choice; p: every visit. s=3.
f: only Another-day users who mistype; i: stale valid-looking grid lets a wrong-day booking proceed, caught only if they read the confirm day; p: each invalid entry. s=3.
f: every booking passes step 2; i: must recall the slot; p: recurs. s=3, rated 2 because the confirm step restates day and slot before anything is committed.
f: van/trailer residents without a permit; i: they cannot complete the core van booking without finding the application elsewhere; p: one-time per resident. s=2.
f: only lapsed holds; i: message gives no reason and no link, slot blanked, primary button invites futile retry; p: per occurrence, Change slot link is nearby. s=2.
f: every day change; i: under one second of blank area, slots then appear; p: recurs. s=1.
f: screen-reader users; i: orientation only, h1 and page content partly compensate; p: every step. s=2.
f: keyboard/screen-reader users who hit vehicle-step errors; i: must tab to the control themselves; p: each error. s=2.
f: any resident whose plans change (core task 2); i: task impossible online, requires a phone support contact and is impossible evenings/weekends; p: every change. s=4.

f: cancelled-status pages are uncommon; i: screenshot shows h1 'Booked' plus 'Show this at the gate' under a cancelled status, risking a wasted trip and being turned away; p: persists while the page is kept. s=3.
f: only when Next is pressed within 0.9 s of a day change; i: silent no-op, a second tap works; p: transient. s=1.
f: small phones at 360 px or less; i: w320 screenshot shows the right slot column pushed to the edge/clipped, sideways scroll; p: every visit on that device. s=2.
f: keyboard-only residents (named in context); i: no visible focus among ~29 slot tiles, risk of choosing the wrong time; p: every visit, not learnable. s=3.
f: every booking; i: 1.5 s with no visible change at the commit step invites repeat taps; p: every submission. s=3.
f: residents interrupted mid-flow (common in context of use); i: slot lost and discovered only at the last step; p: occasional users will not remember the limit. s=3.
f: every booking; i: unchanged form for ~1.5 s after tap, uncertainty and repeat taps; p: every submission. s=3.
f: cancelled bookings are uncommon; i: heading 'Booked' and gate instructions contradict the single red status line, risking a wasted trip; p: persists each time the page is reopened. s=3.
f: keyboard-only residents; i: verifier screenshot shows focused slot drawn the same as neighbours, wrong-slot risk; p: every visit. s=3.

f: every day change; i: about a second of empty list; p: recurs. s=1, rated 2 because the stale 'Monday 12 October' caption over the empty list makes a 'no slots' or missed-tap misreading more likely than a plain blank.
f: every booking, worse for low-vision residents; i: selected day hard to see but the Slots caption names the day in text; p: every visit. s=2.
f: first-time van/trailer residents; i: help may be missed, permit field is still visible; p: until learned, occasional users. s=2.

f: screenshot shows 10 Few-left tiles above 'Morning' on most days for all users; i: Morning appears to have only 3 free slots, afternoon slots look like morning, must scan every tile; p: recurs each visit. s=3.
f: any resident changing plans (core task); i: no online path, needs a weekday phone call, none at evenings/weekends; p: every change. s=4.
f: every Few-left tag, both themes; i: ~3:1 status text hard to read for low-vision users, time itself remains legible; p: recurs. s=2.
f: every Change slot/Back use; i: reset to Today, re-navigation and risk of booking the wrong day; p: each change. s=3.
f: van bookings with missing/mistyped permit; i: late error after full entry, not linked, field on another page; p: corrected once learned. s=2.
f: van residents without a permit wanting near-term slots; i: wasted choice, restart; p: once per resident. s=2.
f: same-day bookings on the default Today; i: whole flow completed before rejection; p: every same-day booking. s=3.
f: every change-slot/back return; i: day reset to Today, re-entry and wrong-day risk; p: every return. s=3.
f: residents who pause over 5 minutes; i: slot lost without warning, choice redone; p: occasional users never learn it. s=3.
f: every Change slot; i: probe produced a Monday booking instead of Saturday, wrong-day arrival risk; p: each change. s=3.
f: anyone who pauses mid-flow; i: lost scarce slot and redo; p: recurs for occasional users. s=3.
f: every completed booking; i: no day/time/vehicle on the record kept for the gate, rely on memory or SMS; p: persists until the visit. s=3.
f: lapsed holds only; i: no recovery instruction, slot blanked, details kept; p: per occurrence. s=2.
f: double taps, made likely by the 1.5 s no-feedback wait; i: booking silently stored as cancelled, loss of the booking and a turned-away trip; p: recurs for any impatient tap. s=4.
f: screen-reader users with vehicle-step errors; i: error not announced on the control, extra searching; p: each error. s=2.
f: most residents bring a car; i: hesitation over an unmarked permit field, Next works without it; p: learned after once. s=2.
f: same-day bookings, Today is default; i: three steps of input before rejection; p: every same-day visit. s=3.
